Printable weekly planner

Open Week 2027

A printable weekly planner with two pages for every week. October 26, 2026 to January 2, 2028. Letter and A4.

Start here
Dated weeks from Monday, October 26, 2026 to Sunday, January 2, 2028
Two pages for every week, Monday start
Print map on page 5: print one month at a time

Start here · Print check · Print map · Year · Dates to remember · Dates to remember 2

Before you print

Start here

1

Download on a computer

On Etsy, open You, then Purchases, then Download files, in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download files). You get two PDFs: Letter for US paper and A4 for the rest of the world. Open them in any PDF reader, such as Adobe Acrobat Reader, Preview or Chrome. No app, account or subscription is needed.

2

Print the check sheet first

Print pages 3 to 4 on one sheet, double-sided, with Scale set to Actual size or 100% and paper size matching the file. Measure the ruler and look at the four corner marks. The back of the sheet lists the fix for each problem.

Page 3
3

Print one month at a time

The Print map lists the pages for every month, and each row is whole sheets. Print pages 1 to 8 once. Buying in October to December 2026? Print Head start November next; its first week begins Monday, October 26. Buying later? Print the current month's row and start this week.

Page 5
4

Punch and bind

Print each row double-sided, flip on long edge, and every week opens as a two-page spread. The binding edge is the wide margin: use a 3-hole punch, a disc punch or a binder clip. No double-sided printer? Print odd pages, put the stack back in the tray, then print even pages.

TipMissed a week? Skip it and start with this one. Need extra weeks or a fresh copy? Print that month's row again, or the Spare week row, as often as you like.

Front of the sheet

Print check

Turn over
Scale check: true-size rulersHold a real ruler to the 5 inch and 12 cm marks. If they match, the scale is right.
Corner marks. All four corners showing means nothing is cut off. They sit half an inch from each edge of the paper.
Lines should be light but clear
Writing lines
Dot grid
Filled box
Pen test: write here to check your pen does not bleed

Back of the sheet

Print check

Start herePrint map
Same way up?This side should read the same way up as the front. Hold the sheet to the light: the corner marks should sit on top of the front ones.
Something looks wrong?
Ruler too short or pages shrunk: set Scale to Actual size or 100% and turn off Fit to page
A corner mark is missing: set paper size to match the file (Letter or A4)
Back side upside down: choose Flip on long edge
No double-sided printer: print odd pages, put the stack back in the tray, then print even pages
Too much ink: print in grayscale or draft; every page works in black and white
Still not right? Send the shop an Etsy message with a photo of this sheet
Settings that work
Paper sizeSame as the file: Letter or A4
ScaleActual size or 100%
Double-sidedFlip on long edge
ColorColor or grayscale, both work

Pages by month

Print map
